headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Hyderabad: Police seize firecrackers worth over Rs 22L, arrest 3.
Farmers led by BRS leaders stage protest at canal regulator in Choppadandi.
Yards to be set up for seized vehicles in every taluk: Minister.
Masked settlers attack European diplomats in occupied West Bank.
BJP SC Morcha alleges that neglect of SC hostels, threatens protest.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad: Police ne Rs 22L se zayed ke patakhay zabt kiye, 3 afraad giraftar.
BRS leaders ki qayadat mein kisano ne Choppadandi mein canal regulator par ehtijaj kiya.
Har taluk mein zabt shuda gaariyon ke liye yards qaim kiye jayenge: Minister.
Maqbooza West Bank mein naqab-posh aabadkaron ne European diplomats par hamla kar diya.
BJP SC Morcha ne SC hostels ko nazar-andaz karne ka ilzaam lagaya, ehtijaj ki dhamki di.
